ROGER

o: ROGER
AFFIRMATIVE
SAY AGAIN

o: REPEAT
WAIT
CORRECTION

o: As soon as you can reach it
Only once it stops swinging
Never — the winchman grabs you
why: The wire carries a static charge until it earths.

fig.title: Helicopter lift
lines: Winchman being lowered on the wire

q: The helicopter lowers a weighted hi-line to your yacht. What do you do with it?
a: Pull it in by hand, keep it loose — never tie it
o: Make it fast to a strong cleat to steady it
Tie it to the casualty's harness at once
Let it trail in the water until the lift
why: The helicopter must be able to break away at any moment.

q: How do you prepare the deck?
a: Drop the main, secure the boom and loose gear
o: Hoist full sail so the yacht rolls less
Hoist the ensign so the helicopter can see you
Send all the crew below out of the way
why: The downdraught catches anything loose; the winchman needs a clear area.

fig.title: Helicopter coming
lines: Cushions and sail bags on deck

q: In what order do you act?
a: MAYDAY first, then launch the raft
o: Launch the raft, then MAYDAY from it
Launch the raft and stay off the radio
Stay aboard until the deck is under
why: The MAYDAY goes from the yacht's fixed VHF while it still works.

fig.title: Sinking
lines: Deck nearly awash, she is going down
Liferaft in its cradle, grab bag ready

q: You have one minute before stepping into the liferaft. What do you take?
a: The grab bag and the EPIRB
o: Passports and phones
The ship's papers
Spare fuel
why: The grab bag and EPIRB are what get you found and kept alive.

q: How do you place the yacht to the wind?
a: Bow to the wind, so the smoke blows aft
o: Stern to the wind, to stop her rolling
Beam on to the wind, to keep her steady
It makes no difference once sails are down
why: Keep the fire downwind of the crew.

fig.title: Fire aft
lines: Fire under the cockpit, out of control

q: You are anchored off Hvar with no VHF and need sea rescue. Which phone number goes straight to MRCC Rijeka?
why: In Croatia 195 is the sea search-and-rescue number; 112 also works.

q: How do you call for help first?
a: MAYDAY on VHF: coastguard and boats nearby hear it
o: Phone the hospital in Bodrum for an ambulance
Phone the charter base and ask for advice
Wait a few minutes to see if he recovers
why: A VHF MAYDAY reaches every station in range at once; a phone call reaches one.
